evidence: bare_number_card: seg2:mid/end: the headline claim, '0 of 7 networks', is a teal blob with '7' in it next to a tiny outlined '0'. It is a number on a shape, not a demonstration of the myth failing.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid/end shows a huge teal circle labelled '7' and a tiny outline '0' whose label crashes into the circle's edge. Data stands on top doing nothing.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The 'zero of seven networks matched' claim went to a generic bubble-size chart. A zero has no size to show, so the payoff number of the video ends up as an empty dot.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw 7 brain networks as 7 lit regions or wires that Data tests one at a time with a probe or switch. Each one fails to light only one side, so all 7 end up firing across both halves, and the tally reads 0/7 matched. Keep labels clear of the shapes.
